newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Morocco's bourse ends week 0.28 percent lower.
newsitem.headline: Morocco's bourse ends week 0.28 percent lower.

text.p: The Casablanca stock exchange closed the week on Friday 0.28 lower, with interest centered mainly on the largest firms, including ONA Group, a market analyst said.
The all-share index closed at 681.99 points, down from 683.90 points.
"The bourse index is following a downward trend as the market showed a slight correction compared with the previous weeks," a Casablanca-based stockbroker said.
A blue-chip share drop was also behind the index decline, he added.
ONA group fell six dirhams to 824 from 830 dirhams.
Societe Nationale d'Investissement, the second largest conglomerate closed at 790 dirhams from 776 dirhams last week.
Wafabank, one of liquid stocks, dropped eight dirhams to close at 872 dirhams from 880 dirhams.
But Banque Marocaine du Commerce Exterieur, one of the market blue chips, closed higher at 650 dirhams from 629 dirhams.
Traded volume was not immediately available.
